item.title: Mark Healey Surfed a Massive Outer Reef, and Waimea Bay, on the XL Thanksgiving Swell
item.description: Mark Healey surfed an outer reef during the XL Thanksgiving swell that hit the Hawaiian Islands. Afterwards, he headed to Waimea and snagged a few good ones.

item.title: Nathan Florence Narrates a Drone’s-Eye View of Pipeline
item.description: Nathan Florence took a quick break from the action to fly a drone over Pipeline and offer some off-the-cuff analysis of the proceedings.

item.title: A Surf Photo Worth a Thousand Words, Or So
item.description: The author reminisces about finding surf in Boston when his father moves back East for love. New England surf ain't easy, but it's worth it. Every time.

item.title: Surf Cams Capture Mysterious Footage of…Honestly, Who Knows?
item.description: Surfline's camera caught some strange happenings in the sky above Ventura Point on the morning of Thursday, December 4, at 4:46 a.m.

item.title: Don’t Fear, Winter Is Here: Mountain Hardwear Mineral King All Season Review
item.description: Weather-resistant and easy to set up, the Mountain Hardwear Mineral King 3 All Season is the perfect year-round backpacking and car camping tent.

item.title: Climber Charged With Manslaughter After Leaving Girlfriend Alone Atop Austria’s Highest Peak
item.description: A 33-year-old woman died 160 feet from the summit of Grossglockner, Austria's highest peak. Now, her boyfriend is being charged with manslaughter.

item.title: Right-Of-Way Dispute Leads to Court Summonses for Keystone Skier, Snowboarder
item.description: A right-of-way dispute between a skier and a snowboarder at Colorado’s Keystone Resort turned contentious last week, ending in violence and a court summons.

item.title: Ocean Beach on January 24th, 2024 Is a Day Worth Reliving
item.description: Ocean Beach is a notoriously hard place to surf. On January 24, 2024, everything aligned. It was the kind of day "surfers dream about but almost never score."

item.title: Gold Coast Dredging Project Births a Brand New Wave
item.description: In his latest video, Dylan Graves documents his pursuit of a break birthed by a dredging project on the Gold Coast in the wake of Cyclone Alfred.

item.title: Finders Keepers: Tanner Gudauskas Examines ‘Shelter’s’ Green Bonzer Experiment
item.description: In "Finders Keepers," Tanner Gudauskas explores the history of the green bonzer surfboard from the movie "Shelter," and its impact on surf culture.
